title: mvp123.com
description: this is a medieval modpack for low end pcs built for nice terrain, new biomes, new weapons and magic, etc
body:
this modpack is made for a medieval vibe to play with friends that have low end pcs which includes

-nice terrain
-structures
-new ores & armors
-and more

this allows for a beautiful environment which can lead to relaxation, and earth like terrain
